option_relations.rationale: Acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction is a specific type of ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Cardiac tamponade due to ventricular wall rupture is a complication, not the primary diagnosis of ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Acute inferoposterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is a specific type of ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Subacute left ventricular free wall rupture (LVFWR) complicating acute myocardial infarction is a complication, not the primary diagnosis of ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
